I think the join direction is wrong—linking channels to teams then to user_teams pulls in every user on that team rather than just the actual channel member, so the filter isn't correctly scoping down to the right person.

I need to join user_teams.user_id directly to channel_members.user_id so the identity carries through the whole path correctly.

The right path is channel_members to users to user_teams, joined on user_id at each step, filtering users.real_name for "Robert" and user_teams.team_id for T01WORKSPACE. This preserves identity properly so only the specific member's own user record and workspace membership are checked, which should yield exactly the 8 rows for Robert Walsh and Robert Chen.
